title: Expose top-level robot triage
rationale: The first agent-discovery command should work without requiring the nested doctor namespace.

title: Expose top-level capabilities JSON
rationale: Agents need a stable machine-readable contract from the binary itself.

title: Expose top-level robot docs guide
rationale: A paste-ready in-tool guide avoids external README lookup during orchestration.

title: Accept global --json on the main workflow
rationale: Agents commonly try --json for structured output; hashbytes stdout is already JSONL, so accepting the flag is the least surprising behavior.

title: Make refusals actionable with next_command
rationale: Refusals previously emitted null next_command even though the spec promised a concrete next step.

title: Teach safe alternatives for doctor --fix
rationale: A legible but unavailable repair request should explain the read-only alternatives instead of generic parser help.

title: Align docs and release formula with Homebrew token
rationale: The tap formula is cmdrvl-hash while the installed binary is hashbytes; docs and generated formula should match that reality and pass brew audit.
